name: Valence Check
description: Verify that the total valence electrons available in a proposed bonding arrangement are consistent — a necessary condition for a stable molecule. CHEM_VALENCE looks up each element's valence electron count from the preloaded group table; CHEM_BOND accumulates bond counts. The check: sum of valence electrons across all atoms equals twice the number of bonds plus the count of lone pairs. Catches impossible structures before any geometry computation. Outputs a 1-bit validity flag.
author: system

pipeline.note: Sum valence electrons across all atoms (preloaded group table)
Downstream: INT32_EQ checks sum_valence == 2*bonds + lone_pairs → valid bit

validation: CH4: C(4) + 4×H(1) = 8 valence electrons, 4 bonds → 8 = 2×4 ✓. CO2: C(4) + 2×O(6) = 16, 4 bonds (2 double) → 16 = 2×4 + 8 lone ✓.
